```plato

    //==
    // The corners of one vertex.

    // The number of faces meeting at a vertex, which for a closed manifold is
    // also its edge count: one outgoing corner per incident face.
    VertexDegree(self: PolygonMesh3D, vertex: VertexIndex): Integer
        => self.CornerCount
            .MapRange(c => self.Faces.Values[c].Equals(vertex) ? 1 : 0)
            .Reduce(0, (acc, hit) => acc + hit);
```
